agent-jasna-bio:
Jasna is a versatile, communicative, and open-minded person who stands out in business with her analytical knowledge and abilities to find solutions to problems closely related to the property-legal status of all types of real estate. In addition to years of field practice, Jasna has experience in drafting lease agreements, compiling accompanying documentation, and providing support in the realization of sales and leases of high-budget properties.

Knowledge of market trends, supply and demand conditions, and all links in the chain, from the moment of meeting the client and their needs, to realization, has made this young person reach serious realizations in the real estate market. Her need for constant advancement and improvement led her spontaneously from the position of partner to independently establishing a modern company CONCEPT Real estate. With its development, the possibilities of the newly established company are also developing, which provides services in all areas that are closely related to the real estate and investment sector.

A person who approaches each client as a new challenge, successfully and safely solves the most difficult problems that arise on the road during the performance of activities, such as: negotiation, compilation of documentation, consultations with renowned legal teams, cadastre and the judicial system. Her persistence and understanding of the problems in which clients find themselves distinguish her from the competition in this sector and make her a leader who has adapted well to modern business.

For years, as a director and partner, she led a successful team of real estate agents and companies that are well positioned in the real estate market and they still exist today. She completed her professional practice as an agent in a renowned real estate rental company and established excellent relations with clients, associates and numerous diplomatic missions both in the region and with the diaspora.

She graduated from the Faculty of Agriculture in Zemun in 2009 and received her doctorate from the Faculty of Natural Sciences and Mathematics in Belgrade in 2018.

During her stay in Spain (2007), as a scholarship holder from the EU and Serbia, while practicing her profession, she managed to perfect her Spanish language. Today, she has active knowledge of Spanish and English at a high level, and uses German passively.

Married, mother of two children - Mihajlo and Vera.
agent-maja-bio:
Maja has been part of the Concept Real Estate company team since its establishment, where she performs a key role in managing administrative affairs and maintaining constant communication with clients.

Her charisma, efficiency, and decisiveness ensure that clients receive accurate and quick information, and all services are provided in the shortest possible time.

As the face representing the company, Maja brings with her a smile and a solution for all challenges, making every interaction positive and productive.

faq-subtitle: Everything you need to know about our services

faq-list.question: What types of properties does JBL Concept offer?
faq-list.answer: JBL Concept offers a wide range of premium properties, including luxury apartments, houses, villas, commercial spaces, and exclusive investment properties in the most attractive locations. Our portfolio includes properties in Serbia and other attractive locations throughout the region.

faq-list.question: What does the property buying process look like with JBL Concept?
faq-list.answer: The process begins with an initial consultation where we define your needs and desires. We then present carefully selected properties that match your criteria. When you find the ideal property, our team guides you through the complete process from negotiations, legal documentation to the final purchase closing, providing expertise at every step.

faq-list.question: What types of properties does JBL Concept offer?
faq-list.answer: Our sales services include professional photography and marketing material preparation, market value assessment, strategic property positioning, targeted marketing to qualified buyers, organization and conducting of visits, negotiating on your behalf, and complete administrative and legal support until the final transfer of ownership.

faq-list.question: What services are included when selling my property?
faq-list.answer: Absolutely! We have extensive experience working with international clients and can provide comprehensive support in multiple languages. We understand the specific requirements of clients who don't live in Serbia and can coordinate the entire process remotely, with transparent communication and efficient administration.

faq-list.question: What are the advantages of engaging JBL Concept instead of direct buying/selling?
faq-list.answer: By engaging JBL Concept, you gain access to our exclusive network of contacts, expertise in negotiating the best terms, detailed knowledge of the real estate market and legal regulations, time savings through efficient process management, and significantly reduced stress through professional management of all administrative and legal aspects of the transaction.
